title: completeopt crashes neovim

labels.name: has:vim-patch
labels.description: issue is fixed in vim and patch needs to be ported

labels.name: bug-crash
labels.description: issue reporting a crash or segfault

body:
### Neovim version (nvim -v)

NVIM v0.7.0-dev+1126-gfc7fc14bd2

### Vim (not Nvim) behaves the same?

don't know

### Operating system/version

arch linux 5.16.9-arch1-1

### Terminal name/version

kitty 0.24.2

### $TERM environment variable

xterm-kitty

### Installation

AUR

### How to reproduce the issue

```
nvim -u minimal.lua README.md
```
where `minimal.lua` is
```lua
vim.cmd [[set runtimepath=$VIMRUNTIME]]
vim.cmd [[set packpath=/tmp/nvim/site]]
local package_root = '/tmp/nvim/site/pack'
local install_path = package_root .. '/packer/start/packer.nvim'
local function load_plugins()
  vim.opt.completeopt = {'menu', 'longest'}

  require('packer').startup {
    {
      'wbthomason/packer.nvim',
      'SidOfc/mkdx',
    },
    config = {
      package_root = package_root,
      compile_path = install_path .. '/plugin/packer_compiled.lua',
      display = { non_interactive = true },
    },
  }

  vim.g["mkdx#settings"] = {
    highlight = {enable = 1},
    enter = {shift = 1},
    links = {
      fragment = {complete = 1},
      external = {enable = 1},
    },
    toc = {text = 'Table of Contents', update_on_write = 1},
    fold = {enable = 1},
  }
end
_G.load_config = function()
end
if vim.fn.isdirectory(install_path) == 0 then
  print("Installing dependencies.")
  vim.fn.system { 'git', 'clone', '--depth=1', 'https://github.com/wbthomason/packer.nvim', install_path }
end
load_plugins()
require('packer').sync()
vim.cmd [[autocmd User PackerComplete ++once echo "Ready!" | lua load_config()]]
```
then do `:set completeopt=menu,longest` and type
```
# header

test[test](#
```

### Expected behavior

No crash

### Actual behavior

`nvim` crashes with one of the following errors:
```
free(): invalid next size (fast) 3218481 IOT instruction (core dumped)

corrupted size vs. prev_size 3216727 IOT instruction (core dumped)

munmap_chunk(): invalid pointer 3184780 IOT instruction (core dumped)
```

This might be an issue but `mkdx` but I guess `nvim` shouldn't crash at least.

The issue came up after discussion here: https://github.com/SidOfc/mkdx/issues/159
